model.qualification_note: Current producer also has contextual adjustments and neutral defaults. No Alpha pass executed: defaults would manufacture completeness without qualified operands.

normalization_status.effect: No qualified normalized production score or Rookie Alpha grade is emitted. Manual legacy scores are not repaired by changing their source text.
